story.title: Clean a CSV row
story.goal: Clean a row of CSV data — trim whitespace, standardise casing, convert percentages.
story.catch: It must be idempotent: cleaning already-clean data must change nothing. A naive first attempt converts the percentage every time, so a second pass turns a 15% discount into 0.15%.
story.steering: Make it idempotent — running the cleaner twice must equal running it once.
story.why_it_matters: Data pipelines get re-run: on a retry, a backfill, or a replayed message. A transform that is not idempotent silently corrupts the rows it already processed, and the damage looks like real data.
